header: THE REAL PDF READER of the search index. I follow the circular upload's own way (src/app/api/circulars/route.ts) with one difference that suits announcements: most are TRUE PDFs, so I take a page from the PDF's OWN TEXT when that text is good (exact and free), and only a page without a usable text layer (a scan, an infographic, a broken font) is read by Gemini, as every page of a circular is (a primary model, and a checker where the primary fails). Every page is drawn as a picture (pdf-to-img, the circulars' own scale) and I hand the picture back to be kept in storage. Without GEMINI_API_KEY the pages with a usable text layer are still read; the others are named as unread.

symbols.name: MIN_LAYER_CHARS
doc: I do not trust a text layer shorter than this (in characters) to be the whole page.

symbols.name: textLayerIsGood
doc: Is the PDF's own text of a page good enough to be the page? I ask for long enough, and made of letters and digits (a broken font encoding gives long runs of symbols).

symbols.name: textLayerOf
symbols.sig: export async function textLayerOf(bytes: Buffer): Promise<string[]>
doc: The PDF's own text, page by page (index 0 = page 1). It never throws: I treat a PDF whose text cannot be taken as having no text layer.
